result.answer_string: {"answer": "Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to a particular class (often coded as 0 or 1) by applying a logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features. The model estimates coefficients that maximize the likelihood of observing the training data, and predictions are made by thresholding the estimated probabilities (commonly at 0.5). Logistic regression is widely used because it is simple, interpretable, and works well when the relationship between the features and the log\u2011odds of the outcome is approximately linear."}
